PACK BURST CS-pack-v22 — export the playable CLIFFSIDE SCENE (bare foreground + four parallax layers + follow camera) with the FROZEN exporter (Run C-5 P0-b: the v21 scene (necromancer prop) with the T4a material + T4b G1 component + T4f pierce/labels + the T4h piece-burst kits fire_burst_e0p (v1) and fire_burst_e0p_v2 as the seventh and eighth Tab kits; charter § 4). task_id "CS-pack-v22".

Run exactly once, substituting OUT = the absolute path of this burst's out/ directory: cd /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst && python3 -B -m export.godot_import --cells /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/cells_v7 --out OUT/godot --parallax /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/artifacts/CS-parallax-in-v8 --vfx-kits /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-5/vfx_kits/kits_v9.json --sockets /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-3/sockets_v2.json --props /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/runs/C-5/artifacts/CS-props-v21
Do NOT pass --scene, --vfx or --gear-variant. Do NOT run Godot (the conductor runs the headless proof outside this sandbox). Paste the command's JSON stdout (or its stderr on failure — do not work around a failure) into out/exporter.json. Then write out/README_scene.txt (≤ 15 lines): how to open it (Godot 4.6 → Import → out/godot/project.godot → Run Project), controls (arrows/WASD move, Shift run, Space jump, E or left click cast, Tab = next VFX set), what is in the scene (painted cliffside foreground, the NECROMANCER master still standing in the clearing as a static prop for Matt to walk around, SEVEN static training dummies in the far-plateau clearing — targets for the VFX run —, parallax layers sky 0.12 / far_ruins 0.25 / forest_valley 0.45 / mist 0.70, follow camera at 12.5 % figure height, collision from the walkable data, VFX picker: the SIX-KIT BREADTH TEST — Frozen Orb v3, Blackwater Cocktail, Poisonous Concoction, Lightning Blast, Zeus Chain, Healing Hands — all our own authored painted-pixel kits built to the hybrid oracle spec; no library setstxt.
No image_gen. No code. No writes outside out/. No web. calls_used 0. BUDGET under 10 minutes.
RETURN: receipt task_id "CS-pack-v22"; images []; files: out/exporter.json, out/README_scene.txt, out/godot/project.godot, out/godot/scenes/*.tscn, out/godot/scripts/*.gd with sha256 (PNG copies may be omitted); status; concerns. Never PASS/FAIL.
